name: @pdx-ts/reference-spike
description: Quarantined Authoring Reference spike. Never published, never promoted, deleted on a fail verdict.
_why_build_viewer: The viewer's build script is named build:viewer, not build, because the repository root runs `npm run build --workspaces --if-present`. A spike that joined the release build would be exactly the root integration the design rules out.
_why_mod_import: `#mod` is the alias a scaffolded project gives its own `src/mod.ts`, and a Recipe renders `import { mod } from "#mod"` into every file it writes. Declaring it here is what lets the technology page's Recipe story be the Recipe's exact bytes — compiled and synthesized like every other story — instead of a copy with the import rewritten.

scripts.start:starlight: astro build --root starlight && cd starlight && astro preview

_why_two_viewers: The follow-up spike asks whether a documentation framework can host the same evidence chain the hand-written viewer hosts. Both viewers render the same content/*.mdx and the same data/*.json, so the only variable is the thing doing the rendering. starlight/ is the second one; src/app/ is the first.
_why_preview_cd: astro preview runs as a detached daemon in Astro 7, and the daemon re-resolves a relative --root against its own working directory: `--root starlight` from here becomes starlight/starlight and the daemon dies with "output directory does not exist", reported only in starlight/.astro/preview.log. Running it from inside the directory is the fix. build and check take --root without trouble.
